reviews.text:
Very frustrating experience. I brought my 12-year-old dog in for sudden difficulty walking and clearly listed that as the reason for the visit. After waiting an hour, a vet tech finally saw her and told me they couldn’t evaluate her and that I needed to go elsewhere.

I completely understand if a clinic isn’t equipped to handle neurological issues, but this should have been identified at check-in—not after an hour of waiting with a sick senior dog. I also tried calling ahead multiple times and couldn’t get anyone to answer. This caused an unnecessary delay in getting my dog the care she needed.

I am very frustrated with the service I received today. I have been coming to this place since my dog ​​was 3 months old and have always been treated with respect. Today, the treatment was dismissive and very rude. I hope this comment will prompt you to do something about it.
We love the doctor. He is throughout and kind. We’ve been going for over 9 years and bring all 3 of our dogs

i’m thankful to the kind staff! Vet took his time with my cat and was direct and clear with his explanation of care, you can tell this vet genuinely cares about his fur patients! Price was very affordable. Thank you so much Petcare Express!
Should call it “Petcare You’ll be here all day”. 3.5 hours wait for one vaccination is crazy.
Great vet(s) and pricing! First come first serve

Despite what everything online says, they do not offer any dental work. They know the information is outdated. They don't offer any referrals. It took me several calls to even find out their information is wrong. I didn't even get to be a customer and they pissed me off.
Great place to take care of fur babies

Back again August 2025. I still love the staff, the wait time wasn't long at all and they are still very reasonably priced. Received vaccines, lukemia/feline AIDS, prescription meds for antibiotics,  probiotics, hair ball med, anal gland expression, less than 300! Very clean environment and they care about and remember my furbaby.
Great caring staff and affordable service!
Great service and the staff is amazing!!!

If I could give them no stars, I would. We have taken our dogs here for years, but this place has gone downhill. The vets used to be so kind and would take time to discuss your pet's health with you. Now a tech takes your dog into the back alone, so you are not in an exam room with the vet to discuss your pet's health together. The tech then comes out to the waiting area to tell you they need to run additional tests and that your dog has allergies and ear infections... Finally, the Vet comes out to the waiting area where dogs are barking, and people are checking in and out, to sell you all kinds of medications you need to purchase. When you question what the infections are or what symptoms they saw, the Vet gets defensive, frustrated, and just keeps pointing at the meds you need to buy. Sadly, this is not the clinic it once was.
I would not recommend taking your beloved pets to this place.
Very nice people, they take great care of my dog ​​Coco, good service
Long wait but worth it

Unbeatable prices for vaccinations / exams. Vet techs are sales people. Be explicit about what services you are purchasing, and that you are *only* purchasing those services. They added things to my bill that I noticed were taken off after I clarified I was only paying for shots.

The vet techs DO act like sales people and they often shill tests and preventatives you don’t need if you have a healthy indoor pet. Clarify what services you want and be wary of ‘we recommend’ and long winded rants. I had to say “No thank you, just the shots today” twice for him to understand I did not want to buy medication or unneeded testing.

Incredibly awkward and it has led to some angry confused customers in other reviews.

If you're on a budget this is the best place to take your dog or cat! They're always extremely busy so it may take some time to be seen but as long as you get there early enough you'll always be seen. They don't take care of all veterinarian situations like emergency care so it's good to call ahead and ask. We have a stray cat and her four kittens that we rescued that we have been taking here for almost 2 years now. This place is very busy but the veterinarians and vet techs are some of the best in the business! They always give their complete attention to my cats even the difficult mama cat. Their package prices for vaccines and rabies are very reasonable compared to other places. They also have reasonable prices on Revolt which works just as well as Revolution but it's cheaper. You can go by and pick them up without a visit once your pet has been checked for heartworms and you can also order on line on their website. I highly recommend this veterinarian if you're looking for a new vet!

Very disappointed with the change in service at PetCare Express. 0 stars

I've been a customer of this place for a long time because they used to have excellent service. They always attended to me quickly, were friendly, and the previous veterinarian always explained everything I needed to know and looked for options to avoid overspending. That's why I always took my pets there.

Unfortunately, this time it was a completely different experience. Now there's new staff, and the change in service is very noticeable. I arrived around 3 p.m. with my dog ​​and cat for their annual vaccinations, as I always had, but this time they told me I had to wait for the doctor to approve whether he could see them. It had never been like that before; they always gave me the form to fill out and continued with the process.

I waited in my car, and when I called to ask, they told me the veterinarian would be out right away, but it took about 30 minutes to arrive. When he finally came out, I felt his attitude was rushed and unfriendly. He told me to come downstairs quickly to sign because it was already late. I understand they might be busy, but the way they treat customers also matters.

During the consultation, I felt like this doctor wasn't really listening to what I needed. I only went for the vaccines, but he was very insistent on adding products or treatments that I wasn't looking for. When I said I didn't need something, I sensed annoyance from him, as if the customer's opinion wasn't being taken seriously. I'd never had that experience before; my previous vet only recommended what was necessary and gave me confidence.

Furthermore, after they saw my pets, they left me waiting for about an hour and a half just to pay. The receptionists across the hall didn't seem to be paying attention to the situation; I saw them mostly on their phones. When I asked what was happening, they told me they were waiting for the doctor's results, but no one came to tell us anything.

In the end, they charged me approximately $770, which surprised me greatly because my intention was only to pay for the vaccines. After discussing it, the total came to $340, but it was still much more than I normally paid (previously around $160 for both pets).

I'm very sad because after so many years of taking my pets to this place, this was a very unpleasant experience. It wasn't just the price, but also the lack of communication, the long wait, the pressure to accept things I didn't need, and the lack of customer service.

I work hard for my money and expected to receive the same treatment and trust as before. Unfortunately, after this experience, I won't be returning.
I got there at 5:05 and they said the doctor can't see my pet.  Nobody answered all day to say that are full.  I have to wait until Monday
This place is great, the ladies and doctor are so nice and very accommodating. Great prices on heartworm, flea and tick medicine. I would recommend anyone with a pet to check it out!
Very long waiting time 2 hours just to get in. Not worth the wait
Their care and patience are top-notch.
I love this place. Always low cost for minor emergencies for my doggy.

First impression, the staff is extremely rude, especially the woman in the front who I talked to first. The website was great, however it is very misleading. They don’t take appointments, so plan to waste a lot of your time. I drove for almost an hour, getting there close to two hours before they closed and still they would not see my cat, saying he required a vet. No kidding that’s why I am here; apparently the only people working there at the time were vet technicians, giving shots and selling flea and heart worm medications. Two and a half hours wasted and my poor cat in a kennel all that time for nothing. I will not be returning, total thumbs down. Being there I got the impression this place cared about money and not pets; total opposite of what the website promised, so sad.

I have been taking my dog for his yearly exams here  for  2 years now , and I  have been more than satisfied and pleased with the outcome of there result. On top of that the pricing is unmatched that makes the wait  feel worth it.
The best wat to go about it is to go early and have them check you in. the turn around is about 1:30hrs.
they make a thorough check on the animals and recombed the best for their needs.
I would recommend this place to anyone over and over again.
Took care of my puppie there so caring. Price great doctors staff wounderful

The issue isn’t the wait itself: it’s being told you’re 7th in line and that it will take less than an hour, only for it to actually take 3 hours before your dog is seen. If it’s going to take that long, why not be honest from the beginning? The staff works there and should be able to estimate the time more accurately. The waiting experience is by far the worst part.

It's a place with good service, attentive staff, and affordable prices. You should be patient because it gets crowded, and the wait time is on a first-come, first-served basis. They explain the service they provide very well and in detail. The only thing I didn't understand was the delay at the checkout; in my case, I waited 1 hour and 10 minutes just to pay.
Long wait but its well worth it

I liked coming here before but now the new people aren’t as good anymore. The prices aren’t low cost anymore. You can’t go in the room with ur dog anymore. You don’t know how they’re handling them. The doctors push a lot of medicine and tests that aren’t necessary. My total is about 500$ each visit and then they pressure us about paying for everything. They dragged my dog to the room, they didn’t even acknowledge him at all. I don’t think I’ll be coming here again, what happened to the doctors that used to work here?
Always helpful

Go for vaccinations only! They will try to upsell you on a variety of other treatments/medications. You will see that the “techs” are well trained salespeople. Reasonably priced for vaccinations, however, medications and treatments are inflated. This place is like the “government office” of pet care. Long waiting times, people vaping in the waiting area, grab your animal and disappear into the back, poor parking, etc…
When I was there, three other clients were diagnosed with the exact same conditions that required an additional $100. Since you are all in the same waiting area you can hear the techs “upselling.” Very suspect!!!
Fantastic service! Been going for about 10 years between the 2 locations. Super affordable vet care. Staff are very nice and knowledgeable.

Ok, I was disappointed to get there only to find out it was closed on a Friday. There's no way of knowing that beforehand because there isn't anyone who can post something somewhere (IG, or even FB or their website). They're understaffed, and it's low-cost, but it sucks if you're driving a long distance.

Still, the staff are very friendly and nice. And the vet, Dr. Chang, is absolutely wonderful; he listened to the health history, read through the past test reports (from another vet clinic), of course, suggested several tests, including a full blood panel (which we couldn't afford + the results would take several days to come back). My dog had multiple visits to other vet clinics and was still having diarrhea a month later. My suspicion was that the initial treatment, which worked, was too short, and therefore, as soon as the initial treatment ended, my dog's diarrhea returned. Anyway, Dr. Chang listened and prescribed 3 antibiotics, Panacur (which is OTC, so buy it and keep it in your first aid kit), and Pro-Pectalin.

And the treatment plan worked! I am so grateful to the vet, the vet techs, and the staff. The care we received was top notch.

That said, be prepared for a loooong wait, and the metal benches are super uncomfortable. We were there from 10:10 am and didn't finish until 4:30 pm. Also, after several hours in the main waiting room, we were called into a small ante-room, where it was another couple of hours, punctuated by a few short visits by the vet tech to ask us questions, then more waiting (there was only 1 hard, metal chair), and then finally, another visit with the vet tech to do tests, the more waiting, and then finally, finally, we got to see the vet. NB: if you don't want to pay the inflated prices (check medication prices on Chewy for comparison) for the medications, you will need to pay $10 for a written Rx. The prices are probably not more inflated than at other vets, but if you're not in a hurry and can order online, you may save money getting the written script. Maybe. Obviously, it depends what the medication is, for how long, etc, but it's worth comparing.
My dog got very sick took him here when my dog looked like he had no more chances , they made me a plan and prescribed medication, my Dog is doing so much better now!
Dental extractions no longer offered. Website’s info needs to be updated.

Tried to bring my dog in today for a sick visit at 4:15pm 2/20/26 their website lists 6pm. I waited in line behind 2 customers then once I reached the front they very passive aggressively said she couldn’t be seen today. I looked around and there were maybe 5 other people in there. Very upset because I had to rush home from work to try and get there early.

First time here and had a great experience . They do seem to get busy but I got there early and did not have to wait . They took care of my dog quickly and the biggest advantage over other clinics was the price . Their prices were great and it actually looks like they really care . Would recommend to anyone
They took care of us quickly in spite of being "walk in's" and were very upfront with all costs and diagnosis with our cats. So far I'm very satisfied with their service and will come back

It’s gone downhill, unfortunately. My dogs have been going here since they were 2-3 years old, now they’re 13 and 15. Now it’s all about selling selling selling and then they treat you rudely when you say no to everything. Staff including the front desk ladies to the vet techs are very rude. And you don’t even get to see the actual vet… the messenger are the rude vet techs trained to sell you more tests that your dogs probably don’t need. Also note: when they say “recommendations”, you’re agreeing to them charging you a test or medication that are likely a temporary fix. I’ve had them wait before so I can research what medications they’re trying to give my pups and I’ve said no to majority because it wouldn’t help long term. They take your dogs to the back but who knows if they’re actually administering those tests or shots? Highly disappointed in this place.

I was one of the first 10 people in line. i still was here a total of 3 hours. Expect at least a 2 hour wait for anything serious. i was only 9th in line and that took at least an hour for them to tell me i needed to see the doctor. they took another hour and only 1 person was in front of me they said. i think people in the room were not getting seen as soon as they get in the room. it’s only 3 rooms. once i got in here i waited another hour it seems.
Friendly and The Best prices

I went here looking for a walk in dog dental cleaning. The front desk staff told me they no longer provide this service since 2024. I am not sure if the service is still offered for existing patients or not. Would’ve been nice to know since I called the listed phone number multiple times before driving across town 30 minutes. The Petcare express website, automated phone service, and many reviews list dental cleaning and walk in available. They should update this & their phone number so people don’t waste their time
So nice and trustworthy. Such a wonderful place to help people that cannot afford petcare. There is a wait but not that bad. Animal lovers will appreciate them so much.
Great service in person but no one ever answers the phone which is concerning.
Wait for five hours just for a vaccine. This place is a waste of time
The clinic is closed and never open. Don’t go
Well run facility and nice staff.
Fast and affordable

Petcare Express has been our vet for several years now because the staff and doctor are great, they go over the invoice and give options that can help fit a budget. The only reason I gave 4 instead of 5 stars is because it is a first come first serve check in, which can result in long wait times and they’d probably address emergencies first. The nice thing is they will call you if you check in and wait somewhere else.
EXCELLENT SERVICE AND VERY FRIENDLY
Nothing but great service  start to finish

This place really takes care of fur babies. My dog Simba has been going there since he was a pup and now he's 7, so to know that he's been going there for a while, describes how great they are with animals. Awesome work!!

They worked well with the XL Bully I took in. They vetted, diagnosed and provided needed meds for her.

The team was very knowledgeable and answered all my questions. They also helped me determine how long to keep her in quarantine - to protect my 2 large dogs.
Puppy check only nothing else and my daughter’s still waiting. Already almost 5 hours and worse case I bet puppies are hungry and so is my daughters. The worse

HORRIFYING!!! Beware!!!!  I had to endure almost 4 hours on my first visit only to be lied to! I returned for the second visit AS INSTRUCTED I was told a different price for my beautiful micro bully, he's 17 weeks old and this place couldn't care less for my baby! It was a simple stitch removal the doctor promised would only be quick procedure thank heavens another clinic answer on such short notice with a non changing price! super unprofessional here.

Hello, good evening. I'd like to know if you can treat my cat. He's 5 months old, has been dewormed once, has never received vaccinations or any other treatment, has caught fleas, and is suffering from skin infections. I'm looking for an affordable place where he can receive medical care. Could you please provide me with some information?

Terrible place. I took my cat to this place on Friday, October 31st. I was in the waiting room for three hours. Okay, I decided to wait. Then, when it was my turn, they took me to a room to wait for another hour. Then they came to offer me blood tests while I waited for the doctor to arrive—my mistake, I accepted them. I paid $246 for them, and the doctor never even came into the room. When it was 3:00 PM, I finally decided to leave and tell them I couldn't wait any longer. It's worth noting that I had already paid for the tests.
They told me they would call on Monday with the results. Today is Tuesday, and they haven't called. And I've called, but they don't answer.
I practically threw my money away. I was so stupid, and I regret it.
Hate this location the vet was super rude. Will not be back.
Great service and staff highly recommend get there early

I have been here several times now and they have been the best priced place vet I have ever seen they also seem to care for animals and I say seem because you can't go back with your furbaby but if my baby hated it other than the normal hates getting her toenails clipped then we wouldn't go back so we're happy or mama is anyway !

Look, I've been using this clinic for a DECADE through at LEAST three pets. There's a "trifecta" for good service. 1) FAST; 2) CHEAP; 3) GOOD. The general rule is that you get to have two of the three to find the service exceptional.

They're RIDICULOUSLY good, ridiculously CHEAP, and yet they take FOREVER if you're not scheduled.

Expect to wait several hours for your pet to be seen if you don't have an appointment and you showed up late in the day. But when your pet IS seen, you will see why you were in the waiting room for 3 hours. The employees TRULY treat your pet like the most important being on the planet once you're in the exam room.

Also, once your pet is on record and up to date, you can just show up and say, *Pet X is sat at home and has fleas. Please sell me medicine for that." They just DO.

The front office people are so nice, the techs are nice, and the doctor is nice.

TL;DR: They're the best, but prepare to wait if you're not there an hour before opening.
They don't answer the phone and you have to go in person to ask any questions you have.
I have been here several times I know they’re always extremely busy but why have a phone number if no one ever picks it up? Like ever!

Gordon is fabulous answering questions about my pet cat. He never seems rushed to move to the next client. The prices are very reasonable. I drive from Katy to Houston on 43rd Street to Petcare Express because of the cost factor.  No appointments so be prepared to wait a long time to be seen.
Fantastic
Excellent service and affordable vaccines

Generally pretty caring vet. However, they stopped providing dental cleanings. Now only the Holcomb location provides them and they require you to wait in line for a “pre-dental checkup” with lines sometimes being over 2 hrs. Not sure why our previous records can’t just transfer over from the 43rd location to the new one or why this location stopped providing the dental cleanings. When they did previously, you were able to make an appointment instead of having you come in twice. Not sure why the Holcomb location makes you come in twice. Seems inefficient and a waste of time… people have to work! Start taking appointments or organize walk ins in a more efficient way please!

The wait was long but the staff was very friendly and explained everything. They took real good care of my puppy and answered all my questions in detail. Prices are very fair for basic shots and the consult visit. They work with you with different treatments according to your budget depending on your issue.
Caring Staff.

Horrible service, long wait times, unorganized. “Pet Express”  yall need to change yalls name to something else cause I had to wait 3 hours just to get a check up. I assume because I wasn’t buying any packages yall decided my pet was not important enough to be seen. I waited 3 hours just to end up buying a flea medicine. Yall have no consideration for people’s time. I was also there last week and same thing happened. Come up with a better system and respect people’s time.

I always learn so much. I asked for help identifying if my dog was having arthritis to manipulate him since his back always goes out. The spine can be so different than the joints and muscles. I also got lucky and Dr Parnham was working, he is the owner.

For those emergnecy moments, Petcare Express has always been there for us! Their staff are here cause they really care!

I just wish cleanliness could be a little better.
Friendly staff but it’s so hard to get ahold of anyone
They never answer the phone!
Always my vets forever !! They are the best

This place was a complete waste of time. They scheduled appointments without a vet even being on-site.

You’re not allowed to accompany your pet into the exam rooms, and the lobby was filthy. We came here hoping our dog’s allergy shot would be more affordable, but it wasn’t.
You have to sign in and wait for a call when it’s your turn. Since we live nearby, we waited at home but even after they called, we still waited over an hour once we arrived. The vet never showed up.

While we waited, we saw multiple people complain. The front desk staff clearly had no knowledge of veterinary care and often said, “I’m just the cashier you’ll have to ask the vet.” Many people ended up leaving angry or frustrated.

In the end, the allergy shot cost more than at our regular vet—and the experience was awful. The only thing low-cost here was the quality of service.

Cheap prices, wait time isn't terrible for no appointments. I would have rated higher if I could have been in the room. When my dog was getting the vaccinations. I understand they do this to be quicker. And get everybody in and out. But how do I really know  My dog got what I paid for I didn't see it.
you might have to wait but it's worth the wait good doctors good price

I’ve gone here a few times and generally received decent care, but a month ago I took my 16 year old cat in because he was urinating and pooping outside the box and seemed off and also has a large egg size bump on his tail base. I mentioned that I thought the cat had stud tail based on the fur condition and perhaps a cyst? The vet did a quick listen to his heart and lungs I guess and told me that the bump was cancer and I would need to take him to a specialty clinic to biopsy and since I wasn’t interested in chemo, he recommended an antibiotic shot, an antiinflammory shot and a anti vomitting shot. He mentioned cancer with my child in the room. I agreed to the meds, but it just didn’t seem right to me and I work in human healthcare. I decided to try lancing the cyst and nothing came out, we left for a 2 day trip. When we returned the bump was mostly gone, it had drained. I noticed the cat had tapeworms which I have now treated for and the bowel issues have resolved and cyst is still quite small and drains. The vet I saw that day clearly was no educated enough to know any better, which is highly concerning.

Dr. Chiang and the staff are super kind and friendly. Jacob showed me how to help my cat with insulin. Adrian assisted him. The ladies at the front desk are very helpful. I would recommend taking a number and having a screen that shows the customer when his number comes up in the queue. Great staff and affordable prices. Thank you!

The Drs and techs are super friendly and kind. I really appreciate their thoroughness with my dogs health. I just went for a vaccine and they ran other tests based on his conditions. Super glad to have crossed paths with them because my Ghosty got the treatments he needed and I wasn’t aware of. I trust them with his health.

Excellent! Professional and dedicated.
You'll have to wait but other than that it's a great place to go.

I'm here with my puppy who had his first parvo shots and showing symptoms again and he's dying on me i told these folks what's happening and they told me I had to wait for two hours i don't even know if my puppy can hold two hours but they didn't care i would recommend please don't bring your dogs here is the worst clinic to come to they didn't care if my dog was dying i hope I can save the little guys life

I've tried multiple times to have my dog seen here for urgent care and every time they've turned him away because they were too busy. The receptionist was completely indifferent to the fact that it was an emergency. I watched them give a dog a shot in the lobby and the lady wasn't even wearing gloves. I also tried called multiple times to see if they were still accepting patients but they rarely ever answer the phone so I drove an hour for nothing. I do not recommend.
Very good experience! Very reasonable prices! Super nice vets and office staff.
Front staff is very rude they look to be new since this was not my first time going.

The only thing this doctor cares about at this clinic is taking money from clients—nothing else matters to him. He took a blood test from my dog without even informing me that my dog needed to be fasting. My dog had eaten beforehand, and as a result, all the test results came back very bad. When I received the results, the doctor contacted me again and tried to charge me more, in addition to the cost of the blood test. He also wanted to sell me some medications, clearly just to make more money. I have absolutely no trust in this clinic. Afterward, I took my dog to another veterinary clinic, repeated the blood tests, and everything came back normal. The office visit is cheap, but they try to charge you for other things. I strongly advise against trusting this place.

I love that it's affordable. I need that. I think many people do. But unless you're one of the first four people here, you will arrive before 10p and still be waiting to be seen over an hour later. And they'll move people ahead of you if you don't opt in for extra shots or tests.

Is what it is. I'm not paying a lot so I'll suck it up, but just be prepared to wait a minimum of an hour to be seen unless you're one of the first four people here.
I was told they no longer do dental cleaning 😢 this is the best place I took my dog for his teeth cleaning. …

This clinic is disrespectful. I arrived with my dog ​​and told them he'd had vomiting and diarrhea. I arrived at 10:00 AM and they didn't see me until 3:20 PM. I saw a doctor attending to a friend or family member. First, they tell you that whoever comes to get vaccinated gets called first, but when you actually come to get vaccinated, it's the same thing. They spend hours with your dog and don't do anything. They leave you on a table and then later they come back with the bill. I'm truly outraged with the clinic and the staff. I wouldn't give it more than one star.

I try to call here but they don’t answer. My dog needed a dental cleaning and I checked their website, and they said dental cleaning was part of their services. I drove a good 30 min to get there…just for them to tell me they don’t do dental cleaning services anymore. My time and money was wasted So I don’t appreciate that. UPDATE YOUR WEBSITE! That’s part of your job!

This place is the best. A few years ago, right before Thanksgiving, I was in a pinch. My dog became sick and my regular vet was fully booked. They did not even try to squeeze me in. Someone recommended pet care Express to me, and when I went out, they treated my dog like he was family. They were better than my regular vet; I have not looked back since. Gordon is amazing, the doctor is amazing, all of the techs, everyone. This is now my permanent vet. Not because of cost, but because of the way that they treated me and my dog.

I’ve been going here for almost 8 years and Gordon has become a part of our family. Me and all my doggies love him to pieces. He really cares about my babies. I took my big boy in not to long ago cuz he just got sick out of nowhere. Gordon was so sad and concerned about my baby. He took great care of my baby, and we love him for that. Thank you pet care express and thank you Gordon.

As some of the other reviewers said, this place does not care for cats as much as they care for dogs. Today we went in 20 minutes after they opened and we knew we would have to wait since there were many people there. 2 hours went by and I asked for a time estimate and the staff said we were now 5th in line after being told we were 6 when we walked in. Which did not add up at all considering we saw many people walk in and out who came there after us. Mostly dogs. The receptionist were not very helpful nor kind. She told us the wait would be another couple hours. I have took my two other pets here and had no issues with the wait. But today was unacceptable. It’s not fair seeing people who come in after you leave before you. We ended up leaving and going to another vet. We were able to get seen right away and when I was already home. Pet express called me, seemingly to tell me that our pet was ready to be seen. In conclusion this place is not even cheap it’s not worth the money, when you receive incredibly long wait times and zero hospitality. I will no longer be taking my business there.
I took my kittens.They were so sick. Now they are doing so well.  It's a very affordable place.
Nice place and friendly staff

Such a wonderful place. Doctor Anna and her crew really helped me out with my little doggy Daisy. They cleaned her teeth and did such a great job. It is so obvious that they care and are passionate about  helping people with excellent pet care and at a really fair price. Thank you Petcare Express!!!

This is my go to for taking care of my three dogs. Before you go, know that you will be essentially paying in your time but it is worth it for great affordable vet services for your dogs. Go early and bring something to do to fill the time. They do a fantastic job with my dogs and treat them so well. Much better than most private vet offices we have visited. I love how much the techs truly love their jobs and helping the animals. It’s also great for picking up meds for your dogs. Lastly you can beat the dental cleaning prices! They book out months in advance so I recommend just putting your name on the list early!

I’ve been going here for years. It is a first come first serve clinic so come early and you’ll sign in on a clipboard with a number on it and that’s your place in line. If the parking lot is full, you can park on the street on the side of the clinic. People complain about waiting but the price cannot be beat. $9 office visit fee with INCREDIBLE care. Just make note that you’ll need to take some time out of your day. The three women at the front try their best so please don’t get mad at them, it’s not like they want you to wait. Recently a stray cat showed up to my door looking like he’s seen the worst. He was so scared he pooped in the exam room. The techs cleaned it up, took care of us, and Dr. Chiang answered every question I had + offered additional advice. They knew it was a stray but they were so gentle and non-discriminatory, even after it scratched the techs twice. The manager also taught me how to give medicine to the cat.
